discoveryRecords.voiceSummary: KEC International Limited has notified the National Stock Exchange and BSE regarding the schedule of meetings with analysts and institutional investors. The company will attend the JM Financial Annual India Conference, also known as India Xchange 2026, in person in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. On November 18, 2026, KEC International will participate in the Goldman Sachs India Hidden Gems event via a virtual mode. Additionally, the company will attend the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in person in Mumbai on the same date. These engagements are classified as one-on-one or group meetings. The company notes that dates are subject to change due to exigencies. Any presentations made will align with those available on the company or stock exchange websites. This information is also available on the company website at www.kecrpg.com.
